text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On nights of the new moon, Admire Vega never fails to go out to see the stars in order to speak with her deceased sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each time, she reaffirms her vow to the sister she races for—to whom she will dedicate all the honors she earns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she believes she's alone in this quest, I'm here doing my best to ensure that she isn't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our relationship may still be rocky, but the Twinkles Series waits for no one. We set our sights on preparing for her debut.
